name: The Girl Next Door
source:
An erotical visual novel about relationship and desire between the main character Jessica and her sexy neigbours.

This is the story of one of many unforgettable nights in their house - with a lot of gentle and passionate sex scenes, wherein Jessica tells about her sensual experiences and erotic fantasies.

The story begins with her words:

„When I was around 19 I was still living at home. We had some new neighbors move in next door during the summer and I ended up getting to know them very well indeed. Their names were Natasha and Kevin and they would invite me over all the time to have dinner with them or to watch a movie with them.”

[Slightly altered from [url=https://www.patreon.com/donutbite]Patreon[/url]].
